# DynastyMath

> Free fantasy football start/sit tool and dynasty trade calculator with superflex, TE premium and picks. Import your Sleeper league. Fresh values daily.

URL: https://dynastymath.com/
Last updated: 2026-10-19
Cost: free, no signup, runs in the browser.

## Key facts
- Start score = 0.7 × this week's projected points + 0.3 × season points per game, × injury factor (Questionable 0.85, Doubtful 0.25, Out/IR 0).
- Dynasty values: weighted blend on a 0-10,000 scale — DynastyProcess experts 40%, Sleeper dynasty ADP 30%, Fantasy Football Calculator dynasty ADP 15%, nflverse production 15% —, with a source breakdown and a consensus indicator.
- Trade totals count the best piece fully and discount extra pieces: 100%, 75%, 55%, 40%, 30%, 25%. A trade within 5% is called fair.
- TE premium adds 15% to tight end value. Draft picks for future years are included.
- Sleeper league import uses the public Sleeper API (no login) and fills starting slots including FLEX and SUPER_FLEX.
- Data refreshes every morning from Sleeper, DynastyProcess, Fantasy Football Calculator and nflverse.

## Tools (one page each)
- [Start/sit tool](https://dynastymath.com/start-sit/): Free fantasy football start/sit tool. Type two to four players to get a start/sit call from this week’s projections, season points per game and injury status. The math: Start score blends three signals: 50% this week’s projection (Sleeper/RotoWire), 25% the last three games and 25% season points per game (nflverse, Sleeper), reduced for injuries. Refreshed daily.
- [Dynasty trade analyzer](https://dynastymath.com/trade-analyzer/): Free dynasty trade analyzer. Add players and rookie picks to each side to see whether the trade is fair, who wins and what would balance it. 1QB or superflex. The math: Values are a composite of four free sources (expert consensus, two draft markets and on-field production), with a per-source breakdown. Extra pieces are discounted; within 5% is fair.
- [Sleeper league import](https://dynastymath.com/league-import/): Enter your Sleeper username to get your optimal lineup for this week, power rankings for every team in your league and the best free agents for your roster. The math: Your league loads from Sleeper’s public API. Every lineup slot gets the highest start score, and teams rank by 60% lineup strength + 40% dynasty value.
- [Waiver wire helper](https://dynastymath.com/waiver-wire/): See the most-added players right now, then load your Sleeper league to find free agents who would beat one of your current starters this week. The math: Trending adds come from Sleeper (last 24 hours). With your league loaded, unrostered players are listed and any whose start score beats your weakest starter are flagged.
- [Rookie draft board](https://dynastymath.com/rookie-draft-board/): A free dynasty rookie and startup draft board ranked by trade value. Tick players as they are drafted to always see the best player available. The math: Players are ranked by composite dynasty value (1QB or superflex). Ticks are saved in this browser so you can reload mid-draft.

- [How dynasty trade values work](https://dynastymath.com/how-dynasty-trade-values-work/): Why 2-for-1 trades get discounted, how superflex and TE premium change dynasty trade values, and how to read a trade calculator verdict.
- [How our values work (sources)](https://dynastymath.com/how-our-values-work/): The four sources behind every dynasty value and start/sit score: DynastyProcess, Sleeper, Fantasy Football Calculator and nflverse, with weights.
- [Superflex explained](https://dynastymath.com/what-is-superflex/): Superflex lets you start a QB in a flex spot. See how it changes player values, draft strategy and dynasty trades, plus superflex rankings.
- [TE premium explained](https://dynastymath.com/te-premium-explained/): TE premium gives tight ends extra points per reception (often +0.5). See how it moves rankings and dynasty trade values, and how to set it.
- [PPR vs half PPR vs standard](https://dynastymath.com/ppr-vs-half-ppr/): How PPR, half-PPR and standard scoring change player values: pass-catching backs and slot receivers gain in PPR, touchdown-dependent players in standard.
- [How to make start/sit decisions](https://dynastymath.com/how-to-decide-start-sit/): A 5-factor start/sit routine: projections, recent usage, injuries, matchup and game script, plus when to take the floor over the ceiling.
- [Import your Sleeper league](https://dynastymath.com/sleeper-league-import/): Enter your Sleeper username to load your roster and get start/sit calls for every slot, including flex and superflex. Free, no login.
- [Trade calculators compared](https://dynastymath.com/dynasty-trade-calculators-compared/): Free dynasty trade calculators side by side: value sources, picks, superflex, TE premium, league import and start/sit. See which fits your league.
- [Responsible play](https://dynastymath.com/responsible-play/): Fantasy football should stay fun. Paid contests are 21+ in most states. Free, confidential help is available at 1-800-GAMBLER.

## FAQ
### Who should I start this week?
Start the player with the higher start score: 50% this week's projection (Sleeper/RotoWire), 25% the last three games (nflverse) and 25% season points per game, reduced for injury status (Questionable × 0.85, Doubtful × 0.25, Out or IR = 0). Check the news before kickoff. Injuries and weather change fast.

### How does the dynasty trade calculator value players?
Each value blends four free sources: DynastyProcess expert consensus (40%), Sleeper dynasty ADP (30%), Fantasy Football Calculator dynasty ADP (15%) and nflverse on-field production (15%). Every source is put on the same scale by positional rank. Draft pick values come from DynastyProcess. Sources and licenses are on the values page.

### Why does a 2-for-1 trade look worse than the totals suggest?
Roster spots are limited, so one great player is usually worth more than two good ones. The best piece counts in full and extra pieces are discounted (75%, 55%, 40% and so on), the same idea as KeepTradeCut's value adjustment.

### What counts as a fair trade?
A trade is fair when the two sides are within 5% of each other after the depth discount. Bigger gaps show who wins and suggest players to balance it.

### Does it work for superflex and TE premium leagues?
Yes. Superflex converts every source with the DynastyProcess superflex value curve, which lifts quarterbacks. TE premium adds 15% to tight end values.

### Can I import my Sleeper league?
Yes. Enter your Sleeper username, pick a league, and you get your roster, your best starters for this week in every slot, and your bench. No login or password.

### Where do the numbers come from?
Player info, injuries, stats, projections and ADP come from the free Sleeper public API. Dynasty values blend DynastyProcess (GPL-3.0), Sleeper and Fantasy Football Calculator ADP and nflverse stats (CC BY 4.0). Everything refreshes every morning.

### Is this a betting site?
No. It's a free fantasy football tool for season-long leagues. No bets, no sportsbook links. Paid fantasy contests are for adults 21 and older where legal. If you or someone you know has a gambling problem, call or text 1-800-GAMBLER.
